title: Fugaro credentials service bundle
description: The document in the credentials service's ONE Secret Manager container (Q6, ruled 2026-10-19): a YAML map of credential names to values, read by the service alone (docs/credentials-service/implementation-plan.md, Task C1.11). The keys are exactly the credentials the platform defines — the model credentials, the GitHub App's private key the mint signs with (C2.1) and the upstream Bitbucket credential the git proxy forwards with (D506) — and the loader refuses a key outside them rather than ignoring it. Written by `fugaro creds set NAME` (C1.25) and by nothing else: no workflow may declare the container's name and `fugaro secrets set` refuses it. A value is never logged, echoed in an error or sent anywhere but to the provider the credential belongs to.
$comment: The bounds mirror internal/credsvc/bundle.go's constants, which are the loader's own rules: maxProperties is MaxBundleCredentials (the wire contract's maxTriedEntries, C1.10), maxLength is MaxBundleValueBytes, and the key pattern is internal/config's credentials as internal/credsvc's CredentialKey reads them (config.GitHubAppKeySecret, config.BitbucketSecret, config.AnthropicSecret, config.ClaudeOAuthToken, and config.ClaudeAccountSecret of a name matching config.ClaudeAccountNameRE and config.MaxClaudeAccountNameLen). propertyNames' maxLength is the account family's second half spelled as a whole-name bound: a named account's key is "claude-oauth-token-" (19 bytes) plus at most MaxClaudeAccountNameLen (31), so 50 — the regex alone would admit a dash-heavy suffix of up to 61 bytes, since each of its {0,30} repetitions may consume two characters. It bounds the account family alone; the other four keys are shorter than 50 and are held to their exact spelling by the pattern. The `not` beside it is the account family's one reserved spelling, claude-oauth-token-bitbucket-token: it resolves to config.BitbucketSecret, which is already the upstream git credential's key, and CredentialKey refuses it so that one name never means two credentials. TestBundleSchemaMatchesTheLoader in internal/credsvc holds the two together, so neither the schema nor the loader can be widened alone.
